mapper.select: select * from (select sn.sn_id as snId, sn.P_Id as pId, mn.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, sn.Sn_No as snNo, csnr.snr_id as snrId, sn.Sn_Code as snCode, sn.Sn_State as snState, csnr.Snr_State as snrState, sn.sn_reply_deadline as snReplyDeadline, sn.Sn_Create_Time as snCreateTime, sn.sn_create_Uname as snCreateUname, sn.Sn_Reply_State as snReplyState, sn.Sn_Need_Reply as snNeedReply, sn.Te_Id as teId from Con_Sup_Notice sn left join Con_Sup_Notice_Reply csnr on sn.sn_id = csnr.sn_id left join Pre_Project mn on sn.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=sn.Con_Id ${authSql} ) c ${ew.customSqlSegment}
